test_initializers_api: test the Haiku initializers module to verify Constant, RandomNormal, and VarianceScaling produce correct shapes and dtypes
test_variance_scaling_validation: test the VarianceScaling initializer to verify it raises ValueError for invalid scale, mode, or distribution arguments
test_compute_fans: test the _compute_fans utility function to verify fan-in and fan-out calculations for various tensor shapes
test_orthogonal_initializer: test the Orthogonal initializer to verify it produces orthogonal matrices and rejects 1D shapes
test_identity_initializer: test the Identity initializer to verify it produces identity-like matrices with configurable gain values
